title: Request your residence permit (permesso di soggiorno)

sources.title: Polizia di Stato: Il rilascio del permesso di soggiorno (Italian)

whatItIs: Non-EU students staying in Italy for more than three months need a residence permit for study. You must request it within 8 working days of entering Italy.
You apply at the post office with a kit. The receipt you get is your proof that you applied while the permit card is made.

bring.text: The application form from the post office kit, filled in
A €16 revenue stamp (marca da bollo), sold only in Italy at tobacconists
Copies of every passport page with your personal details, visas and stamps
Your unibz enrolment certificate (the International Relations Office sends it)
Your health insurance stamped by the embassy, or your registration with the Italian health service
Proof of accommodation (rental contract or the owner's signed declaration) with a copy of the host's ID
Proof that you have enough money for your stay (ask the International Relations Office which documents count)
About €116 for the fees: the €16 stamp, €70.46 on the postal payment slip, and €30 at the counter

afterArrival: Pick up the yellow-band kit at any post office, then book an appointment with the unibz International Relations Office to fill it in together.
Pay the postal payment slip of €70.46 (€30.46 for the card and a €40 contribution).
Hand in the kit in person at a post office with a Sportello Amico counter, with your passport. Leave the envelope open. You pay €30 at the counter.
Keep the receipt and carry it with your passport. You also get a letter with the date of your Questura appointment, and the receipt has a login to track your application.

At the Questura (Largo Giovanni Palatucci 1, Bolzano) your fingerprints are taken. Bring your passport and visa, the appointment letter, the postal receipts, 4 passport photos and 1 copy of everything in the envelope.
By law the permit must be issued within 90 days. Collect it at the Questura once the online status says it is ready.
commonMistakes: Missing the deadline. Count 8 working days from the day you enter Italy, and apply in your first days.
Sealing the envelope. It must be handed in open.
Forgetting a copy. You may be sent back if one is missing, so copy every passport page that has a stamp.

Travelling on the receipt alone. It is not a travel document. While your type D visa is valid you can travel in other Schengen countries; before a trip home, check with the Questura that you can re-enter.
whatComesNext: With the permit or the receipt you can open an Italian bank account, if you want one.
Your tax code is normally assigned with this application. Ask the International Relations Office when and how you receive it.
If your stay is extended, request a renewal at least 90 days before the permit expires.
